name: Weather Full Screen
description: A full-screen weather display built to answer "will it rain or snow while I’m out, when, and how much": the precipitation outlook first, a 36-hour chart with amounts and sharp temperature swings called out, radar when something is on the way, the sun and moon arc with the time, and the week, over a living sky that matches the weather. Readable from across the room.
author: Ryan

awayEnabled.title: Mark my time out of the house
awayEnabled.description: Says whether rain falls while you’re out.

rainLikely.title: Count an hour as wet from (% chance)
rainLikely.description: Lower it to hear about smaller chances.

useOpenMeteo.title: Rain and snow amounts from Open-Meteo
useOpenMeteo.description: Free, no key. Adds how much rain and snow to expect hour by hour, and tells sleet, freezing rain and storms apart. Off: chance only, from your weather provider.

showAirQuality.title: Show air quality when it’s bad
showAirQuality.description: In the Now card, only during an air-quality alert or when the AQI reaches the level below. From Open-Meteo, free, no key.

aqiThreshold.title: Show air quality from AQI
aqiThreshold.description: 101 is unhealthy for sensitive groups, 151 unhealthy for everyone.

showRadar.title: Show radar when precipitation is near
showRadar.description: Takes turns with the chart while rain, snow or storms are falling or due soon, or a weather warning is out.

radarLeadHours.title: Bring the radar up this many hours ahead

radarSeconds.title: Seconds on screen for the chart and radar each

radarZoom.title: Radar zoom
radarZoom.description: 5 shows a region several states wide, 7 a few hundred miles, 9 the metro area.

swingThreshold.title: Warn about temperature swings of (°F)
swingThreshold.description: A change this big within 3 hours, in the next 12 hours, gets a note under the current temperature.

livingSky.title: Living sky background
livingSky.description: An animated sky that matches the weather and the sun, in place of the background photo: clouds, rain, snow, fog and lightning.

showSunCard.title: Show the sun and moon arc

showArcClock.title: Show the time inside the arc

showArcCountdown.title: Show the countdown to sunset / sunrise
showArcCountdown.description: Above the time inside the arc.

textScale.title: Text size
textScale.description: Text already grows with the module: about 30 px body text and a 168 px temperature on a full 1080p screen.

cardColor.title: Card color
cardColor.description: A dark color keeps white text readable over bright photos.

nowStrength.title: Now card strength (%)
nowStrength.description: How strongly the card color covers the background: 0 is clear, 100 is solid.

cardBlur.title: Frosted glass (blur)
cardBlur.description: Blurs the background behind each card so text reads over a busy photo.

textShadow.title: Soft shadow behind text
textShadow.description: Keeps text readable when a card is mostly clear.

accentColor.title: Accent color
accentColor.description: The now line on the chart and the date.
